parole.significato: a mollusk of the order Octopoda; an octopus in the broader sense
parole.testo: From Norwegian Kraken, definite singular of krake (“sea monster”).
From Meinung (“opinion”) + -s- + Korridor (“corridor”), a calque of Norwegian meningskorridor.
Early 19th century, from Norwegian ski. Doublet of Scheit.

parole.significato: A seabird belonging to the genera Cepphus of the auk family Alcidae, particularly the black guillemot, Cepphus grylle
parole.testo: From Norwegian teist, from Old Norse þeisti.
Borrowed from Norwegian trønder, from Old Norse þrǿndir, þrǿndr m pl. The Norwegian plural ending was interpreted as the demononym suffix -er.

parole.significato: related or pertaining to Trøndelag, Norway, or its inhabitants, the Thronds
parole.testo: Borrowed from Norwegian trøndsk, from Old Norse þrǿnzkr. Compare and English Throndish.
